newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: STANTRONIC UPS PROFIT FORECASTS AFTER BUYS.
newsitem.headline: STANTRONIC UPS PROFIT FORECASTS AFTER BUYS.

text.p: South African electrical and refrigeration group Stantronic Ltd, listed two months ago, said on Wednesday it was upping its profit forecasts as a result of several acquisitions.
The firm said it now expected to post a turnover for the year to February, 1998, of about 100 million rand and a consolidated profit of 10.4 million rand.
Stantronic had previously not hoped to hit the 100 million turnover mark before the year 2000.
Stantronic added its earnings per share for the period was expected to increase to about six cents.
However, the firm warned the forecasts could change if it was hit by unexpectedly bad trading conditions or other unforeseen circumstances.
Stantronic on July 29 anounced it had bought Legal Computer Systems' (LCS) Equitrac and Benchmark affiliates for R24.3 million.
Stantronic also bought refrigeration businesses Dynatemp Engineering and Dynatemp Engineering Natal, belonging to the Dynatemp group, for R3.40 million.
